# Index

This is the project's index file. It is rendered whenever the whole project
is rendered — used by `test/integration/suite/render-project.test.ts` to
prove that invoking `quarto.renderProject` from the ACTIVE file
`chapters/chapter1.qmd` still renders this file too (the direct regression
test for the plan's §0/§7 D2 headline finding: a bare, argument-less
`quarto render` invoked from a project subdirectory would render only that
subdirectory's own file(s), never this one).
